Gjoa v0.4.6 is a version-only release of the current 0.4.x browser line.

## Changes

- Advanced the displayed product version from 0.4.5 to 0.4.6.
- Produced a fresh, complete set of portable release artifacts for every supported platform.
- No browser behavior changed between v0.4.5 and v0.4.6; the source diff is version metadata only.

## Downloads

- Linux x86_64: tar.xz or AppImage
- Linux ARM64: tar.xz or AppImage
- macOS ARM64: DMG
- Windows x86_64: ZIP

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tompassarelli/gjoa/compare/v0.4.5...v0.4.6
